notes.title: 'MOAI 2: Path to Another World' is available for MAC users!
notes.content:
Greetings, Friends!

[h1]We a happy to announce that [b]MAC-versions[/b] of a fabulous [b]'MOAI 2’[/b] is out now!*[/h1]
Grab your МАС devices and go to exciting adventure to Another World!
[img]https://pp.vk.me/c622027/v622027644/3a540/E0BOvgT2ZP0.jpg[/img]
[i]* available languages: English, German and Russian[/i]
